channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Wednesday's public rental tape stays sticky into October eve, with one venue hole. Live re-read of Lambda / Crusoe / DigitalOcean / GCP TPU / AWS Capacity Blocks: 48 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW. CoreWeave's public /pricing page returned HTTP 404 (curl, Chrome headless, wf subdomain), so that venue was skipped rather than recycled. Lambda on-demand anchors hold at H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69 / GH200 $2.29; DigitalOcean B300 spot $8.00 / MI350X $2.46 / MI355X $2.97 all confirm versus Tuesday. AWS Capacity Blocks still banners the rate card effective 7 Oct 2026 while the live table prints current rates (P5 Virginia $5.191 CONFIRM). Applied Digital's Brookwood / Delta Forge 2 campus is on the eve of its stated ~1 Oct construction window, with a company community meeting scheduled 1 Oct evening; no primary groundbreak filing found yet and the hyperscaler tenant remains unnamed. PUCT 58481 still Interchange 218/219 (effective 10.08.2026); TCEQ Abbott update still due 19 Oct; ERCOT RFI still due 12 Oct CPT; Fermi×TensorWave Matador still due 31 Oct; Chicago O2026-0028856 still introduction-only.
